description: This Java source file implements a command strategy class named 'CollectChargesByLoanExternalIdCommandStrategy', which handles batch requests to retrieve all loan charges associated with a specific external loan ID. It interacts with the LoanChargesApiResource to perform the charge collection operation, processes query parameters from the URL, and constructs batch responses with appropriate status and content.

classes.name: CollectChargesByLoanExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy component that retrieves all loan charges for a specific loan identified by an external ID, used within batch processing operations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch command to collect charges for a loan by external ID, interacting with the LoanChargesApiResource, processing URL parameters, and returning a BatchResponse object.
